name: Routing — Serverless catalog model
summary: Serverless connection (Phi, Mistral, Llama, etc. served by Foundry's catalog). Uses '{conn}/{model}' prefix but is NOT BYOM.
description: Important to distinguish: the prefix shape is identical to BYOM but the upstream is Foundry-hosted, not customer-hosted. This card exists so the matrix doesn't conflate the two.
notes: Skips if AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_SERVERLESS or SERVERLESS_MODEL is unset.
